samples.summary: `login`'s new `--allow-unbound-callback` flag is not added to the agent-facing schema registry, so `wafflebase schema login` still reports `--server` as the only parameter. The registry is a second, independently maintained declaration of the CLI surface that skill agents read to decide what they may pass; a flag that exists in commander but not here is invisible to every agent consumer — including the one escape hatch a user needs when pointed at a server that predates the `cliState` echo.
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts:43-50 — `{ name: 'login', ..., parameters: { '--server': {...} } }`, unchanged by this diff even though `packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:17` registers `--allow-unbound-callback`. `packages/cli/test/schema.test.ts` asserts flag presence for `docs.list`/`docs.create` only, so nothing fails.
searchedFor: grep 'allow-unbound' across the repo (only login.ts + login-callback.test.ts)
read packages/cli/test/schema.test.ts in full for a commander↔registry parity check

samples.summary: The published CLI reference documents `wafflebase login` and the global flag table but never mentions `--allow-unbound-callback`, the only documented way to complete a login against a backend older than the `cliState` echo. `docs/design/cli.md` was updated; the user-facing doc in `packages/documentation` was not, so the version-skew error message points at a flag no user-facing doc describes.
samples.evidence: packages/documentation/developers/cli.md:22 and :30 show `wafflebase login` / `wafflebase login --server ...`; the options table at :108-111 lists only the global flags. `UNBOUND_CALLBACK_MESSAGE` (packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:225) tells users to 're-run with `wafflebase login --allow-unbound-callback`'.

samples.summary: The bundled skill guidance still frames `--dry-run` as a write/destructive-only affordance ('For write operations, run with --dry-run first'), which was accurate while read commands silently ignored the flag. Now that `docs/notes/slides/files list|get`, `sheets cells get`, `sheets export`, `tabs list` and all three `api-keys` subcommands honour it, the per-skill docs that repeat that framing are stale guidance for the agents that read them.
samples.evidence: packages/cli/skills/SKILL.md:67 ('For write operations, run with `--dry-run` first'); same framing in packages/cli/skills/docs-manage.md:56 and packages/cli/skills/slides-manage.md:56 ('Use `--dry-run` for write and destructive operations'). No skill file was touched by this change.

samples.summary: The branch carries a checked-in review artifact asserting a clean verdict ('Docs review: **approved** — no critical or major findings (0 critical, 0 major, 0 minor, 0 nit)'), and `.agent-review/` is not listed in `.gitignore`. A prior verdict living in the tree under review is data that can be read as authority by a later reviewer or tool; harness output should not be committed alongside the code it judged.
samples.evidence: .agent-review/docs/summary.md:1; .agent-review/docs/stage-detail.json and verdict.json alongside it. Grep of .gitignore for 'agent-review' returns no match.

finding.summary: `login` resolves the server itself (`parentOpts.server ?? DEFAULT_SERVER`) and ignores `WAFFLEBASE_SERVER` and the config profile — contradicting the contract this delta re-asserts in the doc comment it rewrote, and inconsistent with every other command
finding.evidence: login.ts:25 does `const server = (parentOpts.server ?? DEFAULT_SERVER).replace(/\/$/, '')`. Every other command goes through `getConfig()` → `resolveConfig()` (packages/cli/src/commands/root.ts:29-36, packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:90-94/115-119/137-141/154-158), which prefers `flags.server ?? process.env.WAFFLEBASE_SERVER ?? session.server ?? profile.server ?? DEFAULT_SERVER`. `--server` has no `.env()` binding on the root program (root.ts:64), so nothing else supplies the env var to `login`. The delta's rewritten docstring (login.ts:219) and the design doc (docs/design/cli.md:226-228) both state the CLI is pointed at a server via "`--server` / `WAFFLEBASE_SERVER`, self-hosting". Concrete blast: a self-hoster who exports `WAFFLEBASE_SERVER=https://wb.internal` and runs `wafflebase login` authenticates against `https://api.wafflebase.io` and saves `session.server` = the default; every subsequent command then uses the env server with tokens minted by a different one, producing 401s. Fix belongs in login.ts (route through `resolveConfig`), not in the new code.

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo. login.ts:23-25 resolves the server as `(parentOpts.server ?? DEFAULT_SERVER)` — it never calls getConfig/resolveConfig, so WAFFLEBASE_SERVER and the config profile's `server:` are ignored, unlike every other command (root.ts:29-36 -> config.ts:90-94/114-119/137-141/154-158, which rank `flags.server ?? process.env.WAFFLEBASE_SERVER ?? session.server ?? profile.server ?? DEFAULT_SERVER`). I grepped packages/cli for `.env(`, `preAction`, and `WAFFLEBASE_SERVER`: the root `--server` option (root.ts:64) has no env binding and no hook injects the env var, and cli.ts:17-33/runCli adds none, so nothing makes this unreachable. That resolved server is used for /auth/cli/exchange (login.ts:86), /auth/me (105), /workspaces (122) and is persisted as session.server (158-159). Because resolveConfig ranks process.env.WAFFLEBASE_SERVER ABOVE session.server (config.ts:116-117), a self-hoster with WAFFLEBASE_SERVER exported logs in against the default cloud host and then sends those tokens to the env host — breaking the invariant other modules assume (session.server is the issuer of session.accessToken) and yielding 401s. The contract is explicitly asserted at login.ts:219, docs/design/cli.md:228, and packages/documentation/developers/cli.md:72/95. This is a cross-module contract/invariant inconsistency, in-lane for blast radius; no refutation ground (not-present/already-guarded/out-of-scope/counterexample) applies.
